title: News feed
summary: Show each user a feed of recent posts from the accounts they follow.
functional: Read the home feed newest first, paginated
non_functional: A new post appears in followers' feeds within a few seconds
Accounts with millions of followers must not stall delivery for everyone else

posts_per_user_per_day.why: Some post several times, most never; one per user on average.

average_followers.why: Typical median-to-mean follower count on mature networks.

feed_reads_per_user_per_day.why: Users open the app about ten times a day.

post_bytes.why: Text, ids and timestamps; media is stored separately.

feed_entry_bytes.why: Post id and author id per cached feed entry.

feed_length.why: Keep the newest 500 entries per user in the feed cache.

fanout_writes_per_second.why: Throughput of the fan-out workers writing into feed caches.

derived.name: fanout_per_day
derived.label: Feed inserts per day if every post is pushed

derived.name: peak_fanout_qps
derived.label: Feed inserts per second at peak

derived.name: peak_feed_reads
derived.label: Feed reads per second at peak

derived.name: post_storage_per_year
derived.label: Post storage per year, with replicas

derived.name: celebrity_fanout_seconds
derived.label: Time to push one celebrity post to every follower
